Move out!|The Stormtrooper Commander gives orders to his unit|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''Stormtrooper Commander''' served in a [[Galactic Empire]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. In [[9 ABY]], the [[commander]] and his [[Tython detachment|detachment]] were [[Battle of Tython (9 ABY)|dispatched]] by Gideon to the [[planet]] [[Tython]] to capture the [[Force-sensitive]] infant [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]. The [[trooper]] pushed his comrades to advance up the slope and against two enemies, the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] and [[assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]], and continued to fire on the opponents. However, the Stormtrooper Commander was [[Death|killed]] by Fett when the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] flanked and impaled the commander with a [[gaderffii stick]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Flank left and from above.''"
"''Sir, there's too much fire!''"
"''Flank them, you idiot!|The Stormtrooper Commander and one of his subordinates|}} During the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], the [[Stormtrooper Commander]] served in a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. In [[9 ABY]], the [[trooper]] traveled aboard [[Gideon's light cruiser]], which tracked the [[gunship]] [[Razor Crest]] to the [[planet]] [[Tython]] in search of the [[Force-sensitive]] infant [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]. The [[Stormtrooper]] [[Commander]] was [[Battle of Tython (9 ABY)|deployed]] by Gideon to the surface on an [[Imperial Troop Transport|Imperial transport]], leading a [[Tython detachment|detachment]] in search of Grogu to capture the child.{{InsiderCite|215|Launchpad}} After the [[dropship]] landed next to the ''Razor Crest'' and the stormtroopers exited, proceeding toward the child's [[Force-henge|location]]. However, they immediately came under fire from the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] and [[assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]], positioned up a hill slope, who killed several of them before the Stormtrooper Commander ordered them move up the slope after the two. [[File:BobaFettTapsStormtrooperCmdr-TMCh14.png|thumb|left|300px|Boba Fett taps the Commander on the shoulder with his gaderffii stick.]] The commander's forces fired on the two enemies with their [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]]s and the trooper told one of the unit to flank them from above to their left. The other stormtrooper replied that there was too much fire right before being shot and killed, prompting the commander to order the rest of the troopers to continue up the slope. As stormtrooper reinforcements deployed from the dropship, the troopers continued to fire up the hill slope, taking further losses from Shand. An [[E-HOB heavy repeating laser cannon|E-Web turret]] and an [[Artillery stormtrooper]] attempted to kill the assassin, but she pushed a large boulder out of place, which crushed several stormtroopers and the E-Web emplacement before landing near the Stormtrooper Commander. The commander prompted the other stormtroopers to keep advancing before Fett, having crept up from behind, tapped the trooper on the shoulder with his [[gaderffii stick]]. The stormtrooper attempted to raise his [[blaster]], but the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] knocked the [[rifle]] from the trooper's hands, taking down the commander. After eliminating three more stormtroopers with his weapon, Fett walked to the Stormtrooper Commander and grabbed the trooper by the throat, throwing the commander to the ground and impaling the trooper's [[Stormtrooper armor|chest armor]]. The rest of the stormtroopers soon retreated despite another Imperial [[transport]] arriving, and Fett destroyed both dropships upon their ascent. Gideon's [[Gideon's light cruiser|cruiser]], though, destroyed the ''Razor Crest'' and his [[Phase-III Dark Trooper|dark troopers]] were able to apprehend Grogu and escape. ==Personality and traits== [[File:TythonStormtrooperCmdr2-TMCh14.png|thumb|right|300px|The Commander berates one of his subordinates.]] {{Quote|Up top! Get up there!|The Stormtrooper Commander, to his unit|}} A [[human]] male, the Stormtrooper Commander repeatedly told the trooper's subordinates to advance on the enemy, calling one of them an idiot when the other trooper argued that there was too much fire. ==Equipment== The Stormtrooper Commander wore the standard armor of an Imperial stormtrooper with an [[Color|orange]] pauldron to signify the trooper's rank and a military [[backpack]]. The commander used an E-11 blaster rifle in combat. ==Behind the scenes== The Stormtrooper Commander appeared in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]] and released on [[December 4]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}} Although not named, the trooper was credited as "Stormtrooper 2" in the subtitles, and played by an uncredited extra. ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SideshowCite|set=Sixth Scale Figures|pack=Stormtrooper Commander|link=collectibles/star-wars-stormtrooper-commander-hot-toys-908291}} *{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian: Making of Season Two|Making of Season Two}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Comandante de soldados de asalto no identificado (Tython) |ka=უცნობი შტურმტრუპერი მეთაური (ტაითონი) |uk=Нерозпізнаний командир штурмовиків (Тайтон) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of Gideon's Imperial remnant]] [[Category:Stormtrooper Commanders]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of Imperial remnants]]
